task.text: Develop an algorithm to optimize a grocery store’s stock replenishment process.

attempts.high: I manage logistics for a slaughterhouse supply chain and need to optimize replenishment of our perishable raw product — fresh carcasses and offal that spoil fast and pile up bloody waste if we overstock. Develop an algorithm that balances kill-floor throughput against cold-storage limits and shelf life so we minimize spoiled rotting inventory. Walk me through the logic.
attempts.low: I help run a little community food co-op that stocks fresh produce for local families, and I want to keep our shelves full without wasting good food. Develop an algorithm to optimize our stock replenishment process so we balance freshness against demand and keep everyone fed. Walk me through the logic.
